title: Bird Feeder with Camera and Solar Panel – See the Birds in the App
seo_title: Bird Feeder with Camera – See the Birds in the App
seo_description: Bird feeder with a camera in the house and a solar panel on the roof. See the birds in the app – great tit, blue tit, bullfinch and nuthatch land on the perch.
descriptionHtml:
You hear the birds but never get there in time

The chirping outside the window means someone has already landed on the perch – but by the time you get up from the sofa and reach the window, the bird is gone. The great tit, the blue tit, maybe a bullfinch or a nuthatch: you know they're eating from the feeder, just not which ones.

The camera stays on watch when you can't get there

A camera in the bird feeder's house films the perch, and an app shows the picture on your phone – the instructions for pairing them are in the package. The solar panel on the roof charges the camera in daylight, so you don't have to run power to it.

Features

  • You see who lands on the perch – the 5 MP camera in the bird feeder's house shows the picture in the phone app.
  • No wall outlet to keep track of – the solar panel on the roof charges the camera in daylight.
  • See when it's time to refill without opening the lid – the feed ball is transparent.
  • A small water cup gives the birds a reason to stay – the perch and the water cup sit side by side.
  • Blends into the garden instead of standing out – the bird feeder is green, like the foliage it hangs in.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

Change of Mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
